reviews.title: Strong Gameplay, Needs Stability Improvements
reviews.text:
I’ve been playing for about two days now, and overall I’ve had a great experience. The game uses familiar tower defense mechanics but adds enough unique features to make it stand out from other TD games in the genre.
My favorite feature is the Hero system. Being able to equip the Hero with gear that provides meaningful bonuses adds depth to the gameplay and makes progression feel more engaging. While the game progresses at a slower pace, that’s pretty typical for tower defense games. What sets this one apart is how the Hero, Hero equipment, and skill cards work together to create a progression system that feels much more balanced and rewarding than many similar games I’ve played.
The main reason I’m giving 4 stars instead of 5 is due to occasional game freezes. Every so often the game becomes unresponsive, requiring me to completely close and reopen the app before I can continue my run.

reviews.title: Developers are making great progress!!
reviews.text:
I’ll start by saying all the negative reviews recently about the game not loading and stuff are a shame. Those issues have been resolved, and it was not due to the developers actions. iOS forced new player IDs on everyone when the game changed publishers, causing people to lose progress. The developer/owner of the game are deeply sorry and are asking players to contact them through support in Discord to try and get their accounts/progress back!

I’ve been playing this for two years. It has had its ups and downs, but these past 3 months have been incredible. Consistent updates, content releases, bug fixes, balancing changes. 

The developers are interacting with the community via their discord more often and taking in player concerns/ideas moving forward. They have so much cool stuff coming, so stay tuned and come hang out in the Discord with everyone!

reviews.title: Good Game, some bugs
reviews.text:
This is one of the few games I haven’t deleted in 3 minutes so that’s good.  Basically build up your archer, improve stats, beat higher levels etc that type of game. There are some purchases that are permanent to increase speed of play and ignore ads that are definitely worth it if you like the game. You can also buy jewels (in game currency) to speed up the process but that’s not required and you get a small amount of daily jewels anyways.

To the developers, I would recommend adding new landscapes every so often to keep things fresh, consider adding more blessings. Also there are a few bugs including the game freezing when hitting the low 2200s level (I can’t progress any further). Also on the iPad version you can’t see the gameplay screen when you are leveling up your stats (unlike the iPhone version).  And lastly consider not requiring a payment to release jewels from the piggy bank

reviews.title: Very good game….but…
reviews.text: Absolutely love this game! Just downloaded it today and I’m hooked! There are just a couple of complaints that I have! First, I think a basic manual or guide telling the player what each power up does and just basic information about gameplay would be helpful. Also, for some reason the game will not let me add a second “power card”! I bought the second slot for 50 gems and can add the card in the “power card” window but it doesn’t add it when I actually start playing the game. That would be a great help to my game play! Lastly, after purchasing the no adds and the 5x time enhancer, you would think I could get a little better value out of the daily bonuses. As long as this takes to build your character and tower up I could certainly use any extra help! Just some thoughts! But all in all this is a great game with even better potential! Thanks!

Also the rewards stop at wave 100 and their are only 3 levels.  We need more levels or way higher rewards. I also think the chest could get a buff in the amount of gold they give you because right now they give around 60 and the royal chest gives around 200. Another thing that could be added for more content would be more skill cards or add sets like how clash Royale has it. Thanks for reading my rant.

I wish I could have the time back. It’s hard to explain how boring and tedious this is at the end, which feels like a letdown after putting in the time to get there. I am not sure when the game was launched but at this point it could definitely use an update. reviews.title: Good, but annoying flaw
reviews.text:
Good game, slow progression without paying, but there isn’t a paywall, you can definitely play without paying. It’s worth checking out but a pet peeve of mine with games is when they cut off your music when you open the app and switching out, start music and switch back doesnt work, even if you shut off the game music and sfx. That is so very annoying to me. I want to listen to my stuff, not your repetitive music. Not sure why they call it an idle game. There is no offline progression, or at least after six hours it hasn't been made available yet. Overall it’s worth a play. I will keep playing, despite not being able to listen to my music, podcasts, etc. Four stars because it’s not an unbelievably awesome game, but it’s above average.

EDIT: as promised by the dev response, the last update allows you to play your own music/podcasts without the game cutting it off. Yay!

reviews.title: Enjoyable
reviews.text:
I have surpassed lv 400 on the first environment
And around 350 on the last two. I have unlocked all cards(not maxed all) and have really enjoyed this game. I think the current rate of progression is perfect. The only thing I’m really hoping comes to the game is some more stats/environments/classes/cards/enemy types(maybe some unique bosses)
Maybe temporary events that get reset at the end. We just need more content for the other late game players. The only purchase I’ve made is the ad removal, as the game currently stands, the early game content isn’t really enough to recommend any of the other purchases. I will keep playing the game periodically hoping for an update! 

I personally havnt experienced any bugs, or any negative issue with the game, just want the content to go deeper!

reviews.title: I’ll Pay For More Speed
reviews.text:
I love this game, but once you build up your strength, it can take a long time to finish a run.  The Developer added 5x game speed for $5.  I’d like them to add 10x, 15x, and 25x.  I’d glady pay for more game speed.  Developers, if you’re reading this, take my money.  People who love the game will pay for this, because it’s hard to play and have your phone tied up for hours at a time.

But again, for anyone reading this, this is a great game, and it will take you a long time before you want 25x game speed (if the Developers make that available).

reviews.text: I was excited about this game because the game play clips seemed enticing. Good concept and good things going for it but not fun to play. It has a major problem. It allows you to level up your exp gain during the game. This is a major draw back, from a game design perspective because it has little to no impact on the match; barely be felt as a mechanic yet feels necessary to play like this. The need to greed is high in this game and I feel like I zap all my game play drive because I greed 90% of the match. I get 0 visual feedback or power feeling from doing this which takes a lot of the fun out of the game verse just spamming crit or attack speed. Major improvement to the game devs I would say consider highly in making is leveling up exp per mob killed + exp per level to be only exclusively done outside of a match. This leads the player to upgrade more visually receptive nodes through ou

reviews.title: Fun but has a major flaw
reviews.text: Game is enjoyable, but it has a major flaw. If you kill a boss and die at the same time, after you revive, no enemies spawn. Therefore, you have no option other than to leave the level, forfeiting all your accumulated gold and your golden ticket (if you used one). I know, I know, this can’t possibly happen often enough to be a real problem. Well, it does…at least to me(daily).  I purchased the remove ads package, which I (as others have as well) strongly recommend. However, that means that I have to use my free revive. They should just restart the whole level or give you the option to not revive. If they did that, the game would be much more enjoyable and I’d update my rating. If there is a way around this issue and I’m just missing it, please, please let me know. Thanks.

reviews.title: Fun early, Major lack of content
reviews.text: I really liked the early progression in this game. You can tell you’re getting “stronger”. The glaring problems with the game are 2 fold. 1. There’s a big lack of content. There’s only 3 worlds and only rewards up to 100 on each. Once you’ve done that, it doesn’t feel like there’s anything worth doing in the game. Huge problem. Extend rewards, add worlds, gate certain cards to progression, easy stuff here. 2. When you’re at level 60+ in a world, speed ticket boost of 50% of the levels isn’t enough to keep the rounds short(ish). I got to level 150 in a world, speed boost gets me to 75, but if I wanted to progress I’d be sitting for half an hour. Make speed boosts progressive at higher levels or unlock 5x game speed at level 75+. See Tap Titans 2 prestige system for ideas on how far to have it go.

reviews.title: Kinda fun, addictive game.
reviews.text: I’ve played this game at least once a day for at least a month. It’s a fun game but nothing ever gets updated. I’m maxed out on almost everything. It would be nice to get some new gear or new abilities. Even though you don’t have to pay to play this game, if you enjoy it, I definitely recommend removing the ads and buying the “blessings”. Which is another thing I wish they would add more of. It just says to keep progressing to unlock more blessings but I’m literally on level 628 and never have unlocked anymore yet. The game is generous with gems and coins though, so that’s a plus. Definitely worth trying the game. I gave it 3 stars cause it is fun and addicting but needs some continuous improvement.

reviews.title: Late game player as well
reviews.text: I enjoy the game, definitely don’t recommend playing it with ads tbh. To slow so unless you are willing to spend 6$ on the game don’t bother. But I enjoy it I have everything currently maxed out that can be maxed out (not everything has a max) highest level over 1000 but I wish there was a way like holding down the spend XP option to spend it constantly instead of tapping a little annoying. Hope they add more content to the game because I really do enjoy it.

reviews.title: End game user here

I highly recommend using your gems to buy or active slots first then chest. For this game to be better they need to add new levels or new modes. The option on the far right is never unlocked at least from my experience and I am on chapter 7 with at least two weeks of gameplay.

reviews.title: I really like this game

As the title states I like this game but I can’t give it 5 stars because a couple of things are “missing”. Such as a way to upgrade ricochet because right now you can only increase it by using active skills/cards, if it was possible to increase it like you do damage or critical that would be perfect. reviews.title: TL;DR the game needs a total overhaul
reviews.text:
So I’ve decided to rate it so low for a variety of reasons:
1. This game was insanely short. With just some leisurely play I’ve managed to beat it in around a week. 
2. There’s nothing worth doing once you’ve beaten the game. No greater challenge no post game and no way to restart without just making a whole new account. 
3. There seem to be many bugs that happen during average play. I’ve had it stall during fights while the timer on skills ticks away and the enemies get closer and even kill you while your character just stands there doing literally nothing. At several points that cost me a run. There’s also a bug where if you keep holding down to upgrade skills once it hits max it will keep eating your gold causing you to waste thousands and have to start runs again. 
4. It’s quite actively the opposite of an idle game. You don’t ever idle. Ever. If you are not actively starting battles

reviews.title: Good but needs better scaling
reviews.text:
The recent update brought out equipment. Cool, stuff to gather and upgrade…

The problem is a lot of gear has pennies for stats…the weapon at blue quality is +28 dmg. As a new player cool, more dmg, but ive played awhile and my base dmg is around 9k, and upgrading during gameplay reaches low 30k. 

Equipment at blue or purple and higher needs more % increases or things to scale. I understand the concern about making items too strong for early levels and new players but % and multiplicative stats will not harm early game, and also give significant buffs to mid and endless mode runs.

Good game, fun to play occasionally and im glad to see more additions to the game. What we need now is a hardmode, a new game +. It won’t change the normal mode progression, or allow to sweep further, and can even drop more rewards(gold increased) in the NG+.

reviews.title: Great game, but a money sink
reviews.text:
Such a shame. It’s quite a wonderful game early on, but it very quickly becomes apparent that it is geared towards you having to spend money.

To get cards, ability slots, or chests you need gems. Early on you will get gems from achievements, but that is a one time deal and it is a paltry amount compared to what everything costs. You get gems from completing rounds, but they go into a piggy bank. You can only store 150 in the bank, so every gem after 150 is lost. Wanna break open the bank? That’ll be 2 dollars. So you have to break it open at 150 or you lose subsequent gems. You are punished for not spending money.

Great game ruined by greed. Such a shame.

reviews.title: It’s ok, for the first 30 min
reviews.text: After you have upgraded everything 5-6 times, which doesn’t take too long, you then have to wait until you earn more gold to upgrade again. So you press play and wait for the first 18 levels to go by, but you can only increase speed by 2x, so you press play and put your phone on charge for 10 min. Then you pick it up and do same. Each one of these runs will get you ~1000 coins which is enough for 1-2 upgrades that are insignificant in game play. You can’t fast forward faster unfortunately, so you sNtch the same level 300 times and you get so sick of it that you delete the game :(

reviews.title: High potential, lackluster delivery.
reviews.text: The game speed (2x) is too slow, it will make many new players delete the game after a few runs when they realize it, make the speed 3x to increase player retention. There’s also a severe lack of content, depth and player interaction: add player equipment to increase build diversity, add leaderboards to increase overall engagement. Once these get fixed the game will surely start to grow very quickly in popularity.

reviews.title: Pretty captivating
reviews.text: Great game so far, have only gotten to round 65 and it gets quite hard from here on out. Recently unlocked the special Christmas event character after completing all the daily events and purchasing the event pass and would really like if those characters came with some special features like their own attack/ability or at least a slight damage or health increase effect. I think that would make me keep playing otherwise it may start to become pretty monotonous from here out

reviews.title: Fun, but extremely slow progression.
reviews.text: I downloaded this game as a big Tower Defense fan. I enjoy the progression and strengthening of your character, but there are a few things that bother me. One, you have to start at the first level every single time you play. Second, you get to a point where your skill upgrades cost so much and you earn so little with a play through, that I literally have to play 10 times before I get past one part of a level. Please boost credit earned on play-throughs, cheapen skill upgrades, or make upgrades boost more attributes.

reviews.title: I Need Special Tickets To Start From The New Chapter?
reviews.text:
I rate it 2 stars for the sole reason that when you unlock a new chapter, you need special tickets to start from that chapter… the game gave me like 3 free ones when i unlocked chapter 2 but once you run out, gotta start from chapter 1 or buy then with gems… sure you can earn gems but later on, that gets slower. So you either pay or start from chapter 1. 
I will continue to play to see if they continue giving you free ones and see how this mechanic of starting over plays out. But as of right now, thats kind b.s. But maybe i will find that its a good thing.

reviews.title: Good game
reviews.text:
Good idle game except there is no idle play? 
But I do like it because I don’t feel compelled to play everyday every hour. I think I found one bug concerning the watch video gifts! If the first video gifts you watch is the speed up boost you get the 6.99 remove add but no video and it counts as 1 but you get no speed up ticket! So for attempting to watch twice you only get 1 ticket! You can avoid this by watching the daily vids first!

reviews.title: Time grinding, not idle
reviews.text:
Important Note: This game isn’t really idle, you can’t let it run in the background and progress. You must be watching it the whole time. 

Liked the game at first, good system to grow stronger and progress to higher levels. Started to feel the time grind after level 40 but they had tickets to let you do 1/2 your max levels in a few seconds. 

Latest update took those tickets out. I don’t have the patience to watch this game for 20 minutes just to return to my max level, then make it a couple more before dying and having to grind it all over again.

reviews.title: Good not great
reviews.text: I only started playing 2 weeks ago and I am enjoying it but the speed tickets were removed and that kinda ruins the game it’s hard to keep doing the same levels over and over from 1 but with the tickets it make it better since I could skip to 50% of my record. Also a offline earning system even a small one would be great for progressing, not really sure how this is a idle game if it doesn’t have at least a small one built in.

reviews.title: Great game…but
reviews.text:
I love the game so far, getting gems is a daily grind but that’s fine.  Leveling up is also nice.  I’m only on the first stage (forest area) but I heard there are at least 2 more, desert and volcano?  Anymore?

One small complaint I have…no costume changes, that would make the game great and worthy to spend money on.  

That is all.

reviews.title: Cash grab
reviews.text: This is not an Idle game. No “idle” progression. There’s no idle gameplay accept for the automatic attacking that takes place. Bought the add remover (overpriced) and now the game won’t allow me to get the 150% XP buff anymore. Additionally, archer will switch off boss just before killing it and attack minions resulting in a loss. Progression feels so slow because you spend 15 minutes of actual time to earn enough gold to increase a talent. Only for that talent to increase my 0.02%. Yes, gold and xp only increase by 0.02% and damage only increases by 4. Which isn’t enough to progress at a normal speed. Save your time and money if you’re looking for an idle game. Terrible experience

reviews.title: This game fell off.
reviews.text:
Can you explain how after every boss battle your gonna hit me with an ad without giving me a reward or anything?
I played this game a bunch when it first started and I go to level 650 but come on. It’s almost impossible to even reach level 50 in 30 minutes  like you should bump up the speed of those who like reach level 300 above because it’ll be insane that every 10 levels I’m watching an AD like that’s insane. You were great once but now it’s just unplayable now. If you’re new go ahead you’ll have fun but be ready for the insane amount of ads while the game runs by itself.

reviews.title: Interface issue
reviews.text: First, there is no way to contact the develop for except for these reviews. That’s a sign to me that they’re only somewhat interested in what we the users have to say. Secondly the three buttons at the bottom of the screen for selecting skill upgrades, they need to be much larger or moved because more often than not it puts me in pause instead of actually activating the skill tree. This is extremely frustrating and I’m about done with this game because of that factor alone.

reviews.title: Good game but time consuming
reviews.text: The games fun. A lot of bugs got fixed, but there’s no way 1 match should last over 1 and a half hours. Only 2 speeds: 1x and 2x. Zero point in the 1x cause that would double the time spent. A quality of life upgrade would be giving 5x-10x etc speed cause it’s WAYYYYY too slow especially if u have to start from level 1 and work ur way onwards. It took me almost 2 hours just to hit level 291.

reviews.title: Mastered but now its too time consuming
reviews.text:
Please place an update on level restarts. I do not have an hour plus of time in order to restart from level 440 and play to well over 1000 every time due to my base stats being so powerful. Please aloow me to start closer to the level I left off at, just as the game allows playing in the lower levels.
I can barley complete 1 full game per day let alone hit my daily goal of complete 2 games.

reviews.title: Could easily be a 5 star game but really lacks content
reviews.text: It’s a pretty great game but it really needs more characters,upgrades,skills and chapters. It’s extremely fun and yes quite addicting but it doesn’t take long to max out the cards. Also the only way to get gems and upgrade your character/cards is to watch 6 ads every 8 hours. There are achievements but they don’t give a lot and they take quite long. Overall it has some issues but is still a good game

reviews.title: Feels like a money grab
reviews.text:
First day: game was fun, there was a double xp thing they give you for the first 24 hours, and got up to lvl 50. Price for upgrades are a little steep for advancing but I guess it keeps you playing. 
Second day: find out there’s no double XP you can purchase to continue from yesterday. So now you’re back pedaling, and personally can’t go past low 30s. The piggy banks cost 2 dollars for 150 gems (not too pricey). Just feel like it’s too slow of a grind and you will have to be a whale to advance at the same rate as day one. Stopped playing until some updates happen.

reviews.title: Too short
reviews.text: I maxed everything I could on day 1 and only paid to remove adds.  There are only 3 levels, so I don’t know what the incentive is to keep playing at this point.  All you have to do is invest gold in extra gold and exp increase for a few hours, and eventually you start outpacing the game.  I went from not beating level 50 on the first level to getting to level 350+ on all three maps within one hour.  Game balance is easily broke.  It was entertaining but needs some work.

reviews.title: This Could Be Great. Right Now It’s Not.
reviews.text:
What’s the point here? Nothing beyond Chapter 9? So many things are wrong here—max rank a skill and spend gems on chests—you can still draw that skill and get 300 gold. 

It takes forever to get gems unless you spend $$. Gold quickly becomes useless. I have millions in gold. Daily rewards—50 gold, 10 gems. Like…what? Devs need to understand how this game scales. 

As it stands, I’m done here. Could have been a lot more fun. Interesting concept. Maybe play for a week and move on.

reviews.title: Too short
reviews.text:
The game is fine. Its what you expect. However, it is very short. There are only 3 levels. You max out your rewards at stage 100 of each level. You can hit that playing a few times a day in about a week. After stage 100 you can keep going, but its kind of pointless. 

Also they say you can “level up” your archer which is not correct. There is no option in game to make your tower bigger.

reviews.title: Balance Patch
reviews.text: The newest balance patch isn’t that. It’s a greed patch designed to force buying in game items. I’ve played this game for years and this most recent update is miserable.  It’s a money grab and might be a good reason to drop this game. I don’t mind watching the ads for bonuses, but this is out of hand by both slowing the game and overly stat checking players on difficulty making the same levels harder to reach and take far longer. Disappointing to say the least.

reviews.title: Bugs
reviews.text:
This would easily be a 4 or 5 star review, but the HUGE problem is the game freezes and erases the gains made during that run. Horrible, horrible bug that needs immediate attention. It would be nice if you could pause a run and come back to it- once you get high enough, even on x5 speed a run can still take 2+ hours. And to spend that much time and then have the run freeze, this makes it 2 hours completely wasted.
Also not enough content.

reviews.title: Game bottoms out fast
reviews.text: I have played the game a bit and after you get gud, it takes 4-5 hours to play a single game.  The restart on progression from golden tickets is level 440.  Most of my games end around level 5000 plus my best being over level 5700. What is the point of a skip function that you still have to play 90% of the content on an idler, that sits there and drains your phone for hours.   Some serious time needs to be looked at for the end game.

reviews.title: Just a money grab
reviews.text: I got tired of watching videos for the reward of 150% experience so I purchased the permanent blessing and now it doesn’t even work even though it says I have it. Tried filing a report about it and requesting a refund, but behold no refundable purchases have been made. That’s pretty interesting because I definitely bought it and it reflects on my bank purchase history. So now here I am with an unusable purchase and no obvious solution to it. reviews.title: Love it! With dev recommendations
reviews.text:
I absolutely love and am addicted to idle games, and this one stands out.

I’ve reached lv1600+ and thought I’d throw in some recommendations for improvement.
- add additional checkpoints for you to be able to use a “speed up” coupon. Currently, using a coupon caps at ~lv450 and is time consuming to get to 1500.
- add ability to buy upgrades in multiples of 1, 10, 100, and 1000
- scale champion abilities to level
- add a leaderboard
- make the caravan buy-ins cheaper, or add 3-5 daily. I’ve reached the point where I one shot it constantly

If these are added it would improve the game quite a bit!

reviews.title: Fun, Addicting, But Please Update!
reviews.text: Okay so after 3 days of playing I’m hitting stage 468 which beats “99.99%” of other players. The game is fun but it needs more content for later game. I’m maxing out a lot of the stats during runs and there isn’t much more I can do to keep progressing. Just a long run dump the gold into stats and gain a few more stages each time, which is a fine loop and all but at the same time, what am I grinding towards? I just hope that further updates are planned that add at least one or two more ways to buff my stats or abilities. Maybe a new relic system that adds new items that have percentage based buffs or abilities or anything really. Anyway I’ve enjoyed the game but as there is no more content to really grind towards for me I guess I’m done for now, if something new gets added I’ll definitely pick it back up! Thanks for reading!

reviews.title: Great time waster- lacking content
reviews.text:
As of writing this review, I have purchased the 5x time boost, Removed ads, and completed up to level 900; which the game claims is above 99.9% of people. I’ll just assume I had more time on my hands than most. The game bottlenecks very hard around wave 200-250, and is almost unbeatable without either a significant time investment, or certain cards (Attack speed boost, and ricochet master). I can get millions of coins a run, and have basically nothing to do but dailies to grind for gems to get cards or equipment. Beyond that, it’s kind of fun to replay and try to get new “gold high scores” where I just pump up the gold per enemy level as much as I can before I lose to inevitable projectile spam. 

TL;DR: Game is fun for a while, level caps and enemy types will get you stuck at points- not much post game content (stage 9 is the last stage).

reviews.title: Level 700 stuff
reviews.text: Game is fun but the game loop is boring, especially where I'm at. Maybe a reset system that lets you keep card progress and some other benefits? Gems make zero sense, why would I spend 280 gems on 2,600 gold when I can buy 9 tickets for 100 gems and get 6mil before adding the bonus 50% from each ticket? I can either get 226,800,000 gold for 280 gems or i can get 2,600. (9m x 9 = 81m x 2.8 = 226.8m) 226.8m/2600 = 87,231 x 280 = 24,424,680 gems / 2,000 = 12,213 x 89.99 = $1,100,00 USD. Why is that even a buyable option in the shop? Why do I start at level 440 when my highest is level 707? With max range and range bonus card I can see beyond the edge of the world. Costumes should give bonuses like a passive mana shield (should just be a stat ngl) or range/attack speed/damage/gold gain increase. More chapters needed honestly. Keep up the good stuff!

reviews.title: Level 1039 New Patch
reviews.text: I never wrote a review for a game. Level 1039 Best build order - Max attack speed first, Max crit second (at around 33/45/60/75% add points into crit damage if you want more damage to kill bosses), Max crit damage third, Max range damage fourth, Max range last. Best abilities to use when actively playing are ricochet, rapid fire and piercing arrows. Easy farm build for endgame Explosive shot + Multi-Shot + Frozen Arrow + Improved Arrows + Deadeye + health regeneration or Ability of Choice. (I suggest rapid fire or ricochet) Good luck. Thanks devs for a great update! Love this game. I play it while I work out. 10/10

reviews.title: End Game Glitches
reviews.text:
This game is great. A lot of people seem to be concerned with the linear progression with upgrades however it’s to scale with progression on the levels. In fact, I believe it may be lopsided once you reach level 2000 on the game. I believe if your experience multiplier exceeds 40x (I’ve had mine to 66x) you start gaining xp fast enough to upgrade your damage faster than the wave health progresses so you can play to infinity. However, I’ve found that once I reach level 2010-2200, my game completely freezes and I have to restart the app. I am unsure if it’s because there are no further levels or my game cache gets too big and bugs out the game. 

For those of you wondering how to progress, there are a few things that will bump your progress dramatically and I believe it will be nurfed in the future. For card line up use: dead eye, explosive shots, multi-shot, elvish eyes, improved arrows,
